meta.description: Attendance, quizzes, games and polls all happen in the same tool, with the same account.

entete.accroche: Attendance, quizzes, games and polls all happen in the same tool, with the same account.

cartes.texte: The teacher prepares the quiz. The link opens in a browser, on a school computer or elsewhere. A code or a QR code leads to the same link.
The teacher adds a document or a link in a section.
You describe your rooms, teachers, groups and rules. Planner places the sessions, and tells you why when it cannot.

lignes.avant: Attendance is taken on a sheet.
lignes.avec: By hand, on the session list: students need neither a phone nor a projected screen.

lignes.avant: The quiz is prepared separately, then shown from another tool.
lignes.avec: Teachers build their quizzes in the studio, then run them in class or leave them for each student to take at their own pace.

lignes.avant: A course document is sent to the students.
lignes.avec: The teacher adds a document or a link in a section.

lignes.avant: A poll is done by a show of hands or on paper.
lignes.avec: Class polls open when the school turns them on. One question, from two to six choices.

lignes.avant: A suggested question is reread on the original document.
lignes.avec: When AI is turned on for your school in the quiz Studio, it can suggest questions that the teacher reviews before sharing them.

questions.question: How does AI take part?
questions.reponse: When AI is turned on for your school in the quiz Studio, it can suggest questions that the teacher reviews before sharing them.

questions.question: How is attendance taken without the student's phone?
questions.reponse: The teacher also marks by hand: present, late or absent. A student without a phone is marked that way.

questions.question: Does the quiz need an application?
questions.reponse: The link opens in a browser, on a school computer or elsewhere. A code or a QR code leads to the same link.
